api-foundations.copy: Toast API exposes message, description, tone, variant, lifecycle state, optional action, dismiss behavior, and live-region priority while Design System foundations own severity language, elevation, motion, timing, and accessibility.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Feedback job: status, progress, warning, recovery, or undo.

props.name: state
props.notes: Lifecycle state: default, visible, action, stacked, or exiting.

props.name: density
props.notes: Density-aware toast scale: sm, md, or lg.

props.name: icon
props.notes: Optional Material Symbol override; defaults from tone.

props.name: onAction
props.notes: Called when the toast action is selected.

props.name: onDismiss
props.notes: Called when the toast is dismissed.
